# How to Replace with Your Real Photos 📸

To personalize this website with real photos of you and your girlfriend:

1. Add your real photos to this folder (`public/images/memories/`):
   - `memory1.jpg` (or `.png` / `.webp`)
   - `memory2.jpg`
   - `memory3.jpg`
   - `memory4.jpg`
   - `memory5.jpg`
   - `memory6.jpg`

2. Open `src/data/memoriesData.ts` and set the filenames or update the captions & dates.

By default, bundled romantic vector artwork (`memory1.svg` through `memory6.svg`) is used so the website works 100% offline with zero broken image links!
